channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Governo anuncia nova etapa de programa para financiar compra de caminhões e ônibus
item.description: The Lula government will announce a new phase of financing for the purchase of trucks and buses, aiming to expand credit access and strengthen support among voters historically aligned with Bolsonarism. The initiative seeks to renew vehicle fleets and stimulate productive sectors, blending economic policy with electoral strategy.

item.title: Quaest: 84% aprovam e 11% desaprovam governo de Ronaldo Caiado em Goiás
item.description: A Quaest poll released on Thursday (30) shows 84% of Goiás voters approve Ronaldo Caiado's government, with 11% disapproving and 5% undecided. Approval is highest among 16-34 year-olds (86%) and those earning above five minimum wages (90%). The survey, registered with TSE as GO-00211/2026, interviewed 1,104 people across 54 municipalities from April 24-28.

item.title: A reação das lideranças evangélicas à rejeição de Jorge Messias para o STF
item.description: Evangelical leaders celebrated the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias for the Supreme Court, calling it a 'victory for Brazil,' while the sole evangelical justice on the Court, André Mendonça, praised Messias and lamented the outcome. The 42-34 vote marked the first presidential nominee rejection in 132 years, highlighting Lula's weakened political standing ahead of the 2026 election.

item.title: 51% aprovam governo de Eduardo Leite no RS, diz Quaest
item.description: A Quaest poll conducted from April 24–28, 2026 in Rio Grande do Sul shows 51% of voters approve of Governor Eduardo Leite’s (PSD) administration, while 39% disapprove and 10% are undecided. In qualitative assessment, 39% rate the government as 'regular', 34% as 'positive', and 24% as 'negative', with a 3-point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Governo decidiu amplificar a crise da derrota histórica de Lula
item.description: Lula's government amplified its crisis by attempting to overturn the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' STF nomination, spending billions in parliamentary amendments and promoting narratives of congressional antagonism. Despite support from some Supreme Court justices and the release of R$ 12.5 billion in amendments, Lula secured only 34 of the 41 required votes. The defeat heightens legislative risks, particularly regarding the veto on reducing sentences for the January 8 acts, which could benefit Bolsonaro.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest: união inédita de PT e PDT no Rio Grande do Sul coloca esquerda na frente para governo
item.description: The unprecedented alliance between the PT and PDT in Rio Grande do Sul, with PT’s Edegar Pretto withdrawing his candidacy to become Juliana Brizola’s (PDT) running mate, has put the left ahead in the 2026 gubernatorial race, according to a Genial/Quaest poll. Brizola leads in all simulated runoffs, scoring 35-37% against Luciano Zucco (PL) at 27%, and nearly 20 points ahead of Gabriel Souza (MDB). In the first round, she technically ties Zucco at 24% to 21%, while Souza trails at 6%.

item.title: Gestão de Caiado em Goiás é aprovada por 84%, diz Quaest
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll shows that 84% of Goiás voters approve of Ronaldo Caiado's (PSD) administration as governor, with only 11% disapproving. Conducted between April 24–28, 2026 among 1,104 respondents, the survey found 69% rated his governance as 'positive', 21% as 'regular', and 5% as 'negative'. Caiado resigned the governorship to run for president in 2026.

item.title: Quaest: 51% aprovam e 39% desaprovam governo Eduardo Leite no RS
item.description: A Quaest poll shows 51% of Rio Grande do Sul voters approve of Governor Eduardo Leite's government, while 39% disapprove. The survey comes shortly after Ronaldo Caiado was named the PSD's presidential pre-candidate, prompting Leite to withdraw from the internal party race and affirm he will remain in office until the end of his term. Additionally, 47% of respondents believe the next governor should change only what is not working, while 33% advocate for a complete overhaul.

item.title: Genial/Quaest: Camilo aparece à frente de Ciro no 2º turno no Ceará, em empate técnico
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll shows Camilo Santana (PT) technically tied with Ciro Gomes (PSDB) in a potential runoff in Ceará, with 44% to 39%, within the three-point margin of error. Camilo also leads Ciro in a first-round scenario (40% to 33%) and outperforms current governor Elmano de Freitas in all evaluated scenarios. In the Senate race, Cid Gomes (PSB) and Capitão Wagner (União Brasil) are in a technical tie, both ahead of other pre-candidates.

item.title: Messias e pesquisas sinalizam vexame. Lula irá se acovardar?
item.description: The article claims President Lula lacks courage, citing his imprisonment during the military dictatorship as historical evidence, and questions whether he will back down amid polls signaling a potential electoral embarrassment in 2026. The reference to 'Messias' appears to be an ironic or metaphorical allusion to a political figure or messianic expectation that fails to materialize.

item.title: PL da dosimetria pode impor segunda derrota seguida a Lula
item.description: Congress is reviewing this Thursday, the 30th, President Lula's veto on the so-called dosimetry bill, in a session increasing political pressure on the Planalto and potentially resulting in a second defeat in under 24 hours. The vote is scheduled for 10 a.m. in a joint session of the Chamber of Deputies and the Senate, with the bill seen as a priority by productive sectors and opposed by the government.

item.title: “Se perderem essa chance, não contem comigo para impeachment no STF”
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre urged right-wing senators to defeat the nomination of Jorge Messias as Attorney General, calling the vote historic and warning that if they missed the opportunity, he would not support them in a potential impeachment of a Supreme Court justice. The remarks were made in private conversations, according to O Antagonista.

item.title: Relatora quer votar PL que reduz impostos sobre combustíveis em até duas semanas
item.description: Relator Marussa Boldrini of the Republicans party wants the bill reducing fuel taxes to be voted on within two weeks in the Chamber. The urgency request has already been approved, bypassing committee review. She has met with Finance Minister Dario Durigan and plans to meet with sector representatives, despite the initial meeting being unproductive due to the minister's resistance to changes in the bill.

item.title: Rejeição a Messias: Senado dá demonstração de força com derrota histórica a Lula e eleva pressão sobre STF
item.description: The Federal Senate rejected Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court (STF), delivering a historic defeat to President Lula and signaling the growing power of Congress over the judiciary. The vote, orchestrated by Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, saw broad opposition and followed months of pressure, with Bolsonaro allies like Rogério Marinho and Ciro Nogueira framing the result as a signal for the 2027 elections.

item.title: Alcolumbre vai ignorar cobrança por CPMI do Master em votação do veto ao PL da Dosimetria
item.description: Davi Alcolumbre, after rejecting Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF, will preside over the joint congressional session to analyze Lula's full veto of the Dosimetry Bill. He is expected to ignore demands for a CPMI on the Master during the vote. The content is exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: “Perde o Lula, ganha o Brasil”, diz Nikolas sobre derrota de Messias no Senado
item.description: Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) celebrated the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, linking the defeat to President Lula's government with the phrase 'Lula loses, Brazil wins'. He stated the outcome represents a gain for the country and a loss for the president.

item.title: Barco com brasileiros é interceptado no mar Mediterrâneo
item.description: The humanitarian flotilla Global Sumud, carrying two Brazilian activists — Thiago Ávila and Mandi Coelho, a federal deputy pre-candidate for PSTU — was intercepted by Israeli forces in the Mediterranean on April 29, 2026, while en route to Gaza. At least 175 activists were detained, and the Israeli Navy released videos showing condoms and drugs found aboard, claiming the mission was a 'PR stunt'. Other Brazilians in the flotilla were redirected to Crete for safety reasons.

item.title: Bolsonaristas buscam derrubar veto de Lula ao PL da Dosimetria
item.description: Bolsonarista opposition seeks to overturn Lula’s veto on the Dosimetria Bill, which reduces sentences for those involved in the January 8 attacks, but fears it could benefit unrelated criminals. To avoid this, they aim to partially uphold the veto, preserving provisions from the Anti-Faction Bill that hardened penalties, using procedural tools like points of order or veto highlights. The goal is to prevent electoral backlash by allowing only subitems I-III of Article 112 of the Penal Execution Law to apply under the Dosimetria Bill, while keeping subitems IV-X voided by the Anti-Faction Bill.

item.title: Rejeição a Messias é destaque na mídia internacional
item.description: The rejection of Jorge Messias for a Supreme Court vacancy by the Brazilian Senate was widely covered by international media as the first such defeat in over 130 years, seen as a significant political setback for President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Outlets including Reuters, AP, EFE, Ansa, The Washington Post, and Bloomberg emphasized the 42-34 vote, the proximity to the 2026 elections, and the opposition’s celebration — particularly by Flávio Bolsonaro — as evidence of weakening congressional support for the government.

item.title: Alcolumbre recebeu parabéns e agradeceu aliados após derrotar Messias
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) received congratulatory messages from allies following the defeat of the Lula government’s nominee for the Supreme Court vacancy left by Luís Roberto Barroso. The rejection of the presidential pick was seen as a political setback for the Executive, highlighting the opposition’s growing influence in Congress.

item.title: 'Governo não ameaça; faz', diz aliado de Lula após derrota de Messias
item.description: The Lula government denied any intention of retaliation following Jorge Messias's defeat in the Senate, stating that the president received the news calmly. The Planalto Palace emphasized there are no threats underway, only the implementation of already-defined policies.

item.title: 'Avião não cai por um fator só', diz ministro do STF em lamento por Messias
item.description: An STF minister lamented the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the court, calling it an irreparable injustice on a personal level, but acknowledged that political defeats rarely stem from a single cause, usually resulting from a combination of factors.

item.title: Lula priorizou Messias e já aceita derrota em veto da dosimetria
item.description: The Lula administration abandoned its effort to uphold the veto on the Dosimetry Bill to focus on securing Jorge Messias’ appointment to the Supreme Court, but Messias was rejected by the Senate 42–34, the first such rejection since 1894. The move was driven by the release of R$13 billion in amendments and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre’s prioritization of the dosimetry bill. With the veto likely to be overturned, Bolsonaro’s sentence could be reduced, which Lula views as undermining the Court’s credibility.

item.title: Com manobra do Centrão, Congresso deve analisar veto de Lula ao PL da Dosimetria
item.description: Congress is expected to overturn President Lula’s veto on the Dosimetry Bill, which would ease the transition from closed to semi-open prison regimes, following the Senate’s rejection of his nominee Jorge Messias to the TCU. The move would benefit those convicted in the January 8 attacks, potentially including Jair Bolsonaro, highlighting weaknesses in Lula’s coalition amid a Centrão-led opposition strategy. Congressional technicians suggest the veto could be split, as parts were already addressed by the Anti-Facction Law, raising the likelihood of a judicial challenge in the Supreme Court.

item.title: Flávio usa sabatina de Messias para expor imagem moderada
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro used the hearing of Jorge Messias to reinforce a moderate discourse, criticizing the Lula government and the STF, especially regarding sentences for the January 8 attacks and amnesty for the convicted. He advocated for broad amnesty and questioned the Supreme Court's role in legislative debates, while Messias emphasized proportionality in sentencing and Congress's authority over amnesty. Flávio's strategy aims to balance institutional confrontation with moderate appeal to broaden his political support amid the ambiguous weight of the Bolsonaro surname.

item.title: Poder360 lança minissérie “Poder nos Trilhos”; assista ao trailer
item.description: Poder360 launches the miniseries 'Poder on the Rails' on May 2, 2026, consisting of five episodes exploring the history, current state, and future of Brazil's railway network. The series combines on-location travel, expert and authority interviews, and historical analysis to question why Brazil has so few trains despite its extensive past network. The first episode premieres on May 4, following a 17-hour journey on the EFVM, the country's only remaining daily passenger rail line.

item.title: Placar em derrota de Messias indica que até senadores próximos ao governo mudaram de lado na votação
item.description: The historic defeat of Jorge Messias in his nomination to the STF revealed fractures in government support, with senators close to the administration voting against him. Despite 18 expected votes from the ideological core (PT, PDT, PSB) and 13 additional pre-announced supporters, Messias received only 34 votes — three fewer than projected — indicating defections within the base. The analysis suggests even senators considered guaranteed switched sides, highlighting weaknesses in governmental coordination.

item.title: Oposição trata rejeição a Messias como vitória eleitoral e prevê impor hoje nova derrota ao governo
item.description: The opposition celebrated the rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court as a sign of Lula's government weakness, interpreting the result as an electoral omen. The defeat reveals the government's inability to unite its congressional base and foreshadows another loss on the veto of the dosimetry bill, which directly benefits Jair Bolsonaro by reducing sentences for those involved in the January 8 attacks. Bolsonarists see this as an opportunity to strengthen their Senate presence and advance efforts to remove STF ministers, while government allies admit they need more time to rebuild their coalition.

item.title: Derrota histórica de Lula, vitória da oposição, tensão com Senado: como imprensa internacional noticiou rejeição a Messias
item.description: The rejection of Jorge Messias, Brazil's Attorney General, for a seat on the Supreme Federal Court by the Senate was portrayed by international press as a historic defeat for President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, indicating a weakening of his ability to build congressional support. El País noted that the 42–34 vote broke the tradition of presidential nominees being ratified, deepening tensions with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre and raising concerns about governability ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Alexandre de Moraes atuou pela rejeição a Messias em votação que impôs revés a André Mendonça
item.description: Alexandre de Moraes operated behind the scenes to support the rejection of Jorge Messias, the Attorney General, in his unsuccessful bid for a seat on the Supreme Federal Court (STF), contributing to a setback for André Mendonça. This effort aligned with actions by Senate President Davi Alcolumbre and presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, all opposing Messias’s nomination. The subscriber-only article highlights Moraes’s quiet but influential role in the STF selection process.

item.title: Alcolumbre diz que só opinou ao prever placar de Messias no Senado
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre claimed he only gave his opinion to Government Leader Jaques Wagner when predicting the vote count that rejected Jorge Messias’ nomination to the STF. However, a video released by TV Senate shows Alcolumbre whispering to Wagner moments before the vote that the nomination would lose by 8 votes — close to the actual 7-vote defeat (34 in favor, 41 needed). The incident reveals that Alcolumbre, who opposed the nomination from the start, had precise knowledge of the vote’s outcome and actively coordinated its defeat, indicating a deliberate effort against the Planalto and Lula’s administration.

item.title: Alcolumbre negociou com direita reeleição para comando do Senado
item.description: Davi Alcolumbre is being backed by the right and the Centrão for his re-election as Senate president in 2027/2028, as part of a strategy to counter President Lula’s influence, particularly regarding Supreme Court nominations. Although he previously received broad support — including from Lula’s government — Alcolumbre has shown flexibility in his principles, accommodating right-wing demands to strengthen his control over the Senate, which holds strategic power in reviewing impeachment petitions.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: cúpula de comissão planeja audiências nas bases eleitorais para ampliar apoio
item.description: The special committee of the Chamber of Deputies, installed yesterday to analyze the PEC ending the 6x1 work scale, has already begun planning to take the debate outside Brasília by holding hearings in electoral bases to broaden support for the proposal. The initiative aims to build political consensus around the workday reform through territorial mobilization.

item.title: Aliada da família Bolsonaro, governadora do DF aposta em encontro com Lula para salvar BRB. Veja por quê
item.description: Distrito Federal Governor Celina Leão (PP), an ally of the Bolsonaro family, requested a meeting with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) to resolve the crisis at the Bank of Brasília (BRB), which has suffered losses due to operations with the company Master. The BRB leadership believes the meeting could unlock a solution for the public financial institution facing operational and financial difficulties. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: Exoneração de secretário de Educação de Minas gera primeiro desgaste de vice de Zema no comando do Executivo'
item.description: The dismissal of Minas Gerais' Education Secretary Rossieli Soares has caused political strain for Vice Governor Mateus Simões, who took over the Executive a month ago following Romeu Zema's departure. While Rossieli claimed the exit was 'aligned with the government,' the state administration denied this, stating he will be held accountable for irregularities under preliminary investigation by the State General Controller's Office (CGE). The case has galvanized left-wing opposition, which accuses the former official and demands transparency in the ongoing probe.

item.title: Indicação só em 2027 pode levar família Bolsonaro a nomear maioria do STF e mudar correlação de forças na Corte
item.description: The Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias for the STF is expected to delay the appointment until 2027, allowing the next president to nominate up to four justices. This could enable the Bolsonaro family to appoint six of the eleven STF members, shifting the Court's balance of power. The scenario is considered a key strategic issue in the presidential race, with Flávio Bolsonaro as the bolsonarist candidate.

item.title: O último veto antes de Messias: há 132 anos, Senado descartava general sem 'saber jurídico' no STF; saiba como foi
item.description: 132 years ago, the Senate rejected two of Floriano Peixoto’s STF nominations: General Francisco Raymundo Ewerton Quadros for lacking 'notorious legal knowledge,' and lawyer Demosthenes da Silveira Lobo due to political accusations. This was the last presidential STF rejection until Jorge Messias in 2024, ending a long streak of automatic approvals. The 'notorious legal knowledge' rule was established after the first rejection in 1893.

item.title: Demora do TSE para julgar cassações permite que governadores depois condenados sigam no poder e gera tensões políticas
item.description: The TSE's delay in ruling on cassation cases allows governors later found guilty to remain in power for nearly their entire term, causing political instability and damaging the perception of Electoral Justice. In Roraima, the trial of governors Edilson Damião and Antonio Denarium, accused of political and economic abuse of power in the 2022 elections, was suspended and will resume this Thursday, after three requests for views delayed the analysis for over three years.

item.title: Contato com indecisos, governistas ignorados e palpite certeiro: entenda como Alcolumbre agiu para barrar Messias no STF
item.description: The Senate rejected the nomination of Jorge Messias, minister of the Attorney General's Office, to the Supreme Federal Court (STF), ending a 132-year streak of successful confirmations. With 34 votes in favor and 42 against, the secret vote was seen as a direct message from Congress to the Judiciary and the Lula government, intensifying inter-branch tensions ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Delúbio lamenta veto a Messias e publica foto com Lula e Janja
item.description: Delúbio Soares, former PT treasurer, lamented the Senate’s rejection of Jorge Messias’ nomination to the STF, citing lack of technical grounds and characterizing it as an electoral move, while sharing a photo with Lula and Janja. His 2026 federal deputy candidacy in Goiás signals the PT’s strategy to revive figures tainted by corruption scandals, following the annulment of his convictions in the mensalão and Lava Jato cases.

item.title: Com Odair Cunha no TCU, suplentes mineiros brigam por vaga na Câmara
item.description: Federal Deputy Odair Cunha (PT-MG) is set to assume a seat at the Tribunal de Contas da União (TCU), vacating his position in the Chamber of Deputies. This has triggered a dispute between two alternates: Glaycon Franco, who left the PV to join the PSDB and seeks to assume the mandate, and Gilmar Machado, a PT member and former mayor of Uberlândia, whom the Minas Gerais PT claims is entitled to the seat under the original coalition that elected Odair. Both sides threaten legal action if not selected by the Electoral Justice.

item.title: Grupo de Tarcísio tentará conversa com Salles para evitar racha em SP
item.description: The circle around Governor Tarcísio de Freitas and pre-candidate Guilherme Derrite is attempting to convince federal deputy Ricardo Salles to abandon his Senate bid in São Paulo, fearing his candidacy will split the right-wing vote and hurt André do Prado and Derrite’s chances. Salles, despite his party Novo officially supporting Tarcísio’s re-election, insists on remaining an 'outsider' candidate. The right risks losing both Senate seats due to fragmentation, particularly as center-left coalitions take shape.

item.title: Congresso analisa veto de PL da Dosimetria em meio à crise com governo
item.description: Congress is reviewing the potential override of President Lula's veto on the Dosimetry Bill, which would reduce sentences for those involved in the January 8, 2023 attacks. The vote follows a government defeat in the Senate over the rejection of Lula's nominee, Jorge Messias, to the STF. If passed, the bill could benefit at least 280 individuals, including former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is currently under house arrest.

item.title: TSE proclama nesta quinta decisão sobre governo de Roraima
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) proclaimed on Thursday (April 30) the ineligibility of former Roraima governor Antonio Denarium (Republicans) by a 7-0 vote and the removal of current governor Edilson Damião (Union) by a 6-1 vote, maintaining the tally formed after vote adjustments by Ministers André Mendonça and possibly Antonio Carlos Ferreira. If upheld, new elections will be called in Roraima, with the president of the Legislative Assembly, Soldado Sampaio (Republicans), assuming the governorship on an interim basis until the new election.

item.title: Alcolumbre comanda derrota de Messias e abre crise entre Lula e Senado
item.description: Senator Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP), president of the Senate, orchestrated the defeat of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF by the Lula government, resulting in 42 votes against and 34 in favor. The maneuver, centered in the Centrão bloc and involving senators from PP and União Brasil, was seen as a political rebuke to the government for alleged arrogance in negotiations, triggering a crisis between the Planalto Palace and the Legislative Branch.

item.title: Desenrola 2.0 terá uso do FGTS? O que se sabe e o que ainda é dúvida
item.description: The Lula government is preparing Desenrola 2.0, to be announced on May 1st and detailed on May 4th, targeting debt renegotiation for low- and middle-income consumers with discounts of up to 90%. A key point under discussion is the potential use of FGTS funds, possibly releasing R$ 4.5 billion to facilitate debt settlements or write-offs, though technical details remain pending. The initiative aims to be fiscally sustainable, avoiding direct Treasury guarantees and exploring alternatives like forgotten bank balances.

item.title: Alcolumbre derrota Lula, Messias e Evangélicos
item.description: Davi Alcolumbre succeeded in securing his nomination to the Federal Supreme Court, defeating President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Attorney General Jorge Messias. His victory also went against a segment of evangelical leaders who had initially backed his nomination, revealing divisions within the conservative religious bloc.

item.title: Messias rejeitado para o STF: uma derrota histórica para Lula - O Assunto #1710
item.description: The Senate historically rejected President Lula's nomination of Jorge Messias to the Supreme Federal Court (STF) by a vote of 42-34, the first such rejection since 1894. The defeat was orchestrated by Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, who favored Senator Rodrigo Pacheco as Lula's nominee. Messias, the Attorney General of the Union, opposed abortion and criticized judicial activism during his confirmation hearing.

item.title: Lula não deve indicar outro nome ao STF para o Senado, dizem aliados
item.description: President Lula does not intend to nominate another candidate for the STF vacancy following the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias, according to his allies. The defeat, the first in 132 years, was attributed to Senator Davi Alcolumbre's opposition, who favored Rodrigo Pacheco instead. The episode heightens tensions between the government and Congress ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Alívio a multas de pedágio é mais uma medida populista e eleitoreira
item.description: The Lula government announced the suspension of 3.4 million toll fines from the free flow system until November 16, shortly after the 2026 election runoff, as part of a series of electoral measures to boost popularity. The move joins other initiatives such as fuel tax exemptions, expansion of the Minha Casa, Minha Vida program for the middle class, and a new household debt reduction program — all seen as strategically timed for the election.
